source.truth: canonical EPIR METAR/SPECI history; corrected 2020-2024 fog truth when available
source.environment: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API

method.resolution: hourly observation truth joined to ERA5 UTC hour
method.storage: monthly sufficient statistics; raw ERA5 arrays are not committed
method.fog_targets: FG, MIFG and BR are separate targets; UNKNOWN observations never become CLEAR
method.low_cloud_target: BKN/OVC/VV at or below 1500 ft AGL from aviation observations
method.convection_target: TS/VCTS or explicitly reported CB/TCU in aviation observation
method.bin_shrinkage: 20 pseudo-cases toward target base rate; diagnostic physical prior only
